subject: Procurement checklist: order form invoicing, wiring, and MSA review
messages:
From: Emily Torres <emily.torres@novacorp.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novacorp.com, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@novacorp.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order form & MSA — procurement checklist and invoicing details

Hi Naomi / Ben,

Thanks for the chat this morning. To keep Procurement moving, here's what NovaCorp needs to confirm before we route to Accounts Payable and Legal: 

- Invoice recipient and legal remit entity (US vs EMEA). If you need a specific invoice format, attach sample.
- Agreed net terms (NovaCorp standard is net45 but can consider net30 on early-pay).
- PO template completed (I've attached our PO template).
- Confirmation of which entity will appear on the order form for tax/residency reasons.
- VAT/residency certificate and any withholding treatment for cross-border payments.
- SOW / activation milestone for ramp and the minimum commit schedule (we need explicit dates for invoicing cadence).

Attaching: NovaCorp_PO_template.xlsx (fyi).

Can you get back with an invoice example and whether Redwood needs a PO number or accepts our PO on signature? We have a tight window to close before Q2 procurement cutoff.

Thanks,
Emily Torres
Senior Procurement Manager
NovaCorp, Inc.
emily.torres@novacorp.com
+1 415-555-0132

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Emily Torres <emily.torres@novacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 6 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form & MSA — procurement checklist and invoicing details

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and a couple of asks from our side: 

- Invoice recipient: we can invoice NovaCorp as requested. By default invoices come from Redwood Inference, Inc. (US entity). If you need an EU entity on invoice, please confirm the remit entity and VAT handling.
- Net terms: Redwood prefers net45 for first-year enterprise deals. We can offer net30 with 1.5% early-pay discount; Ben, pls confirm if that lines up with the pricing team.
- PO: we can accept your PO number on the signed order form. Please include the PO as an attachment when you return the signed doc.
- Minimum commit / ramp: attached is our draft order form (redwood_orderform_draft_v2.pdf). Could you confirm the invoicing cadence you want for the commit (monthly, quarterly, or upfront tranche)?
- Tax evidence: please upload VAT cert and any W-8/W-9s (if US/EU mix).

Looping in Kimberly (legal) to review the Order Form and MSA redlines now so we can keep Legal and Procurement synced.

Next steps: Ben and I will align on pricing cadence and I'll ask Legal to produce a redline bundle by early next week.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Commercial Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_orderform_draft_v2.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Emily Torres <emily.torres@novacorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Mar 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form & MSA — procurement checklist and invoicing details

Emily / team — quick pricing cadence clarification from AE side to help AP: 

- Pricing ladder we discussed (summary):
  * Month 1-3: Pilot usage billed monthly; minimum commit = 50k tokens/month
  * Month 4-6: Ramp at 150k tokens/month (monthly invoices)
  * Month 7+: Steady-state at committed level (quarterly true-up)

- Invoicing triggers: monthly invoices for usage, with a quarterly reconciliation true-up against committed minimums.
- Net terms: we can accept net45. If NovaCorp elects net30, we offer 1.5% early-pay discount applied to the invoice subtotal.
- PO handling: Accept your PO number on the invoice; please include it when returning the signed order form.

Attaching pricing_schedule_v1.xlsx (simple export of the ladder and invoice trigger).

If this matches your AP needs, Emily, please confirm and we'll fold into the redline order form Kimberly is preparing.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: pricing_schedule_v1.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Emily Torres <emily.torres@novacorp.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form & MSA — procurement checklist and invoicing details

Hi all — Legal has reviewed the draft Order Form and MSA and I've summarized the outstanding commercial/legal items below so Procurement and AP have a single source of truth: 

1) Net terms — Redwood requests net45 as standard. We will include the 1.5% early-pay language as an optional exhibit if NovaCorp prefers net30.
2) Invoice acceptance / dispute window — 30 days after invoice receipt; disputed amounts will not delay payment of undisputed amounts.
3) Tax treatment — Redwood will list the invoicing entity as Redwood Inference, Inc. (US). NovaCorp to confirm if reverse-charge VAT applies; if so we will include a VAT field on the invoice and accept VAT exemption evidence.
4) PO / Attachment clause — Order Form will include a PO number field; acceptance of PO on signature is fine. Please attach signed PO when returning.
5) Minimum commit language — updated to include milestone dates and quarterly reconciliation true-up. See redlines.
6) Data & audit clause — minor edits to align with NovaCorp's security appendix; redline attached.

I have uploaded redlines for both documents: MSA_redline_KP_20270309.docx and OrderForm_redline_20270309.docx. For e-signature: I've prepared a DocuSign envelope with the redline bundle here: https://docusign.com/naomi/rc_7412. 

Please confirm the following so I can finalize: (a) invoice remit entity (US vs EU), (b) whether NovaCorp accepts net45 or requests net30 w/early-pay, (c) receipt of the PO and VAT certificate once you upload.

On process: once we receive confirmation on those three items, Legal will finalize the bundle and initiate signature routing the same day.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachments: MSA_redline_KP_20270309.docx; OrderForm_redline_20270309.docx

From: Emily Torres <emily.torres@novacorp.com>

Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form & MSA — procurement checklist and invoicing details

Kim / Naomi / Ben — confirmed on behalf of NovaCorp: 

- Invoice remit entity: NovaCorp will pay Redwood Inference, Inc. (US). Wire details accepted as listed in your draft.
- Net terms: NovaCorp accepts net45 for the initial term. We will not take the early-pay discount at this time.
- PO & tax evidence: I've uploaded PO_7412_NovaCorp.pdf and our VAT_certificate.pdf to your shared Drive folder (link above) and attached them to this reply.
- Minimum commit cadence: we accept the pilot three-month cadence followed by ramp and quarterly true-up as outlined in Ben's pricing schedule.

We reviewed the redlines. Legal (Rajiv) noted one small comment about the invoice dispute window; other than that we can proceed to signature. Rajiv, please confirm you want me to countersign the DocuSign envelope or if Legal will perform signature offline.

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Emily Torres
Senior Procurement Manager
NovaCorp, Inc.

Attachments: PO_7412_NovaCorp.pdf; VAT_certificate.pdf
